title: Stage A: L/T privileged within-class subgroup feasibility screen
objective: Test whether train-only L/T-derived within-class statistical strata transfer to two inner source users and contain incremental information about errors of a fixed Right-only diagnostic probe, conditional on gesture class, audit user, and a matched Right-derived stratum.
not_a_claim: not evidence of true kinematic or motion subgroups
not performance evidence for the historical Right-only CNN
incremental CMI only exceeds the fixed binary Right-cluster control, not all Right-view information
HV7/HV8 labels are class-conditional diagnostic labels, not deployment-time inputs or independent validation labels

data_boundary.quality_rule: Use the canonical shared quality mask: exclude subject 6/class 3 from source rows; the known subject 2/class 10-11 contradiction is outside the source-user selection, and subjects 1 and 2 are never read for labels or radar values.
data_boundary.ids: Original row indices are preserved and hashed; all fitting uses only users 3-6. Users 7-8 are used only after the representations, clusters, and Right probe are frozen.
data_boundary.historical_use: Participants 3-8 have prior development use. Inner source audit is not independent validation and cannot support external-user claims.

frozen_method.input: Existing real-valued clutter-removed X, shape [N,3,90,189], with view order L,T,R.
frozen_method.feature: Per-view magnitude normalization followed by fixed 10x21 block averaging to 210 dimensions; no label-dependent feature search.
frozen_method.subgroups: Within each gesture class, StandardScaler and 16-component PCA are fit on users 3-6 only. KMeans K=2, n_init=10, seed=20261025 is fit once on concatenated L/T features; matched R-only clusters use the identical pipeline on R. IDs are ordered by the frozen first PCA coordinate.
frozen_method.error_probe: One fixed Right-only StandardScaler + RidgeClassifier(alpha=1.0,class_weight=balanced), fit on users 3-6 only; no CNN and no tuning.
controls: Right-only within-class groups from the same cluster pipeline
user identity and class-conditional user error information
1999 random shuffles of L/T group assignments within audit class x user x Right-group strata, preserving counts
frozen_method.primary_statistic: I(Right-probe error; L/T group | gesture class, audit user, Right-only group), in bits per audit sample.
secondary_statistics: cluster occupancy per fit/audit user and class
audit error-rate direction for the two frozen group IDs per class/user

fixed_decision_rule.coverage_gate: At least 8/12 classes must have both groups with >=10 samples in each audit user and in >=3/4 fit users.
fixed_decision_rule.cross_user_error_gate: For at least 8/12 classes, both audit users must show the same group ID with >=5 percentage-point higher Right-probe error, with >=10 samples/group/user.
fixed_decision_rule.permutation_gate: One global fixed-seed, 1999-draw conditional permutation test, p<=0.05; no per-class selection.
fixed_decision_rule.failure_action: Stop the candidate; do not change K, representation, split, groups, probe, threshold, or permutation count based on these results.
fixed_decision_rule.pass_action: Only eligible to request a separate Stage B instruction: compare matched Right-only CNN CE vs the same Right-only CNN plus the frozen L/T group auxiliary target, with L/T unavailable at inference. Include Right-derived group, user-group, and count-preserving random-group controls. Stage A alone is not a contribution.

identity_alignment.within_stage_a: Per-class group IDs are assigned by frozen training-centroid order; audit users receive nearest frozen-centroid IDs. No audit refit, Hungarian matching, labels, or cross-user reassignment.
identity_alignment.across_outer_folds: No group IDs are compared or pooled across folds. Stage B, if separately authorized, fits fold-local group identities from that fold's training users and reports only fold-local diagnostics; cross-fold identity alignment is not claimed.

known_exact_duplicate_triplets.interpretation: These are data-level exact aliases across separately named G11/G12 source arrays, not merely duplicate manifest indices. Provenance cannot distinguish acquisition repeats from upstream copying; both contradictory-label cells were already excluded. No source-user exact duplicate is listed in the preserved manifest.

trial_independence.evidence_available: The preserved manifest has participant/class counts and row indices; source code shows 100 samples in each participant/class cell. The restored cache and reviewed source manifests provide no per-trial timestamps, acquisition order, session IDs, or repeat-level grouping metadata.
trial_independence.implication: The currently proposed record-level conditional permutation within class x audit-user x Right-group is not cleared under possible within-recording dependence. Do not interpret its p-value until exchangeability is resolved.

source_exchangeability.pre_run_action: Block before reading arrays. First recover trustworthy acquisition-session/order metadata and preregister a block-level permutation; if unavailable, ask for a pre-run revision to a descriptive-only Stage A with no record-level inferential p-value, or stop this candidate. Do not invent blocks from row order or change the frozen inferential gate after results.

compute_budget.environment: 5 CPU cores, about 17.7 GB available RAM, about 25.8 GB free at 2026-10-24 preflight; no GPU, no PyTorch, no active job.
compute_budget.execution: Parent supervisor launches one worker through budget_exec.py in a new process group. budget_exec applies Linux RLIMIT_CPU soft=hard=900 seconds then execs worker in the same PID; a separate parent monotonic timer SIGKILLs the group at 900 wall seconds. BLAS/OpenMP/BLIS/NumExpr pools are capped at one thread before worker imports and via threadpoolctl.
compute_budget.hard_budget: 900 process CPU-seconds and 900 seconds wall time. Any timeout yields an aborted/inconclusive terminal status, preserves flushed partial artifacts, and is never classified as a scientific negative.
compute_budget.partial_artifacts: Source-only metadata and low-dimensional feature memmap are flushed every 32 rows; fitted per-class transforms/centroids/remaps and Right probe state are atomically checkpointed; null statistics are flushed every 50 draws. Parent preserves last phase/progress and lists partial artifacts after reaping.
compute_budget.run_manifest: Store initial diagnostic/protocol hashes, Python/platform/numerical-library versions, observed thread pools, model states, null statistics, and hashes of run artifacts outside Git.

known: GEORGE: feature-space subclass clustering and group-robust mitigation without subclass labels.
Domino: cross-modal embeddings plus error-aware mixture-based systematic-error slice discovery.
EIIL: infer partitions informative for invariant learning.
AGRO: adversarial error-prone group discovery coupled to robust optimization.
LUPI and multimodal privileged learning: extra views available during training but absent at inference.
Xue et al. 2026: same-corpus X4 single/dual/tri-view recognition and fusion.
Project P1: cross-user multi-view teacher distillation into Right-only student; multiview OOF-shape control did not beat Right-only OOF or global smoothing.
prior_art_boundary.candidate_difference: Only the untested empirical question of whether L/T defines train-only, class-conditional strata that transfer across source users and add Right-error information beyond a same-pipeline Right-only grouping/user control. The group discovery, privileged information, and robust weighting algorithms are not claimed as new.
prior_art_boundary.novelty_status: not cleared; bounded literature search only
